name: Vintage Story Mod (IronPit)
initializeCommand: set -eu; game_dir="${localEnv:VINTAGE_STORY}"; if [ -z "$game_dir" ]; then flatpak_location="$(flatpak info --show-location at.vintagestory.VintageStory 2>/dev/null || true)"; game_dir="$flatpak_location/files/extra/vintagestory"; fi; test -f "$game_dir/VintagestoryAPI.dll" || { echo 'Could not find VintagestoryAPI.dll. Set VINTAGE_STORY to the game directory, or install the at.vintagestory.VintageStory Flatpak.' >&2; exit 1; }; ln -sfn "$game_dir" "${localWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/.vintagestory"
